s1.desc: a snowy park under a bright sky, with snow-covered pine trees

spans.view: with the two of them side by side on a rose wooden bench

beats.text: Pax looks over at Polly while she gazes off to the side and blinks
Pax shuffles along the bench closer to Polly and slips one flipper behind her back as she glances at him
Pax reaches across with his other flipper and takes hold of Polly's flipper, leaning toward her
Pax holds Polly's fin up to his beak, both with their eyes closed and rosy cheeks, as little hearts float above them
Pax hugs Polly close and presses a kiss to her cheek while hearts drift up
Pax and Polly sit back upright with blushing cheeks and closed eyes, Polly wiggling with her flippers at her cheeks
Pax opens his eyes and glances up happily while Polly keeps wiggling with her flippers at her cheeks
Pax closes his eyes again and lifts a flipper to his cheek while Polly sways bashfully with her flippers at her face
Polly lunges at Pax and squeezes his cheeks hard with both fins while he squints and flings a fin out
Polly presses her face against Pax's cheek, still squishing him, while he blushes with his eyes closed
Polly grabs Pax's fin and hugs it tight against her chest while he smiles with his eyes closed
Polly chomps down on Pax's fin and Pax's eyes pop wide with his beak open in shock
